description: This file defines the 'CodeBlock' class for a Drupal CKEditor 5 plugin, including configuration forms, parsing logic, and default settings for programming languages supported in code blocks.

classes.name: CodeBlock
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for configuring CKEditor 5 code block language options, including form building, validation, and default language settings.

methods.name: buildConfigurationForm
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for selecting programming languages for code blocks.

methods.name: validateConfigurationForm
methods.description: Validates the language configuration form input, ensuring proper format.

methods.name: parseLanguagesFromValue
methods.description: Parses a string of language key|label lines into an array of language configurations.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Provides default language options for code blocks.

methods.name: getDynamicPluginConfig
methods.description: Returns dynamic plugin configuration including selected languages.
